title: Subject
description: Declarative subject-under-test spec for ao-bench (design doc §5.2): claude_cli | ao_workflow | fake. All fields are optional except version/id/type -- each subject type uses the subset relevant to it. Payloads (workflow/reposets/agents templates) are referenced by PATH, relative to this file; never inlined.

id.description: Lowercase kebab subject id, unique among committed subjects.

type.description: Subject type key into SUBJECT_REGISTRY (e.g. "claude_cli", "ao_workflow", "fake"). Closed list enforced by the loader (bench/spec.py KNOWN_SUBJECT_TYPES), not this schema, so new types can be added ahead of registry wiring without a schema edit.

prompt_template.description: claude_cli subject: may reference {instruction} {repo} -- paths only, never file contents.

workflow.description: ao_workflow subject: PATH to a template workflow.json, relative to this subject.json.

reposets.description: ao_workflow subject: PATH to a template reposet.json, relative to this subject.json.

agents.description: ao_workflow subject: PATH to a template agents.json, relative to this subject.json.

template.description: ao_workflow subject, template mode (T-Ov3Sbj): builtin template name (e.g. "overseer-runner") or a template dir relative to this subject.json. The subject runs `ao new <template> ... --run` in the task workspace instead of `ao run --workflow`; `workflow` is then unused.

template_params.description: ao_workflow template mode: `--param key=value` pairs. `repo_set` defaults to the first repo_set in `reposets`.

prompt_file.description: ao_workflow template mode: PATH (relative to this subject.json) whose content becomes the instance's prompt.md (`--prompt-file`). Keep it thin: task content belongs in INSTRUCTION.md and the parity bundle.

init_git.description: ao_workflow subject: make repo/ a git repo (one commit of the task as handed over) with a local bare `origin` outside repo/, for workflows whose stages need git.

scripted_effect.description: fake subject (test-only): scripted side-effect to apply to the workspace.

fake_tokens.description: fake subject (test-only): token counts to report.
